basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost at its Braga plant and put the improvements in place?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the conversion cost per part baseline at the Braga plant and size the improvement opportunities.

gate.label: Initiative go/no-go
gate.decision: Which sized initiatives go forward into implementation at the Braga plant?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Implement the approved initiatives in waves at the Braga plant and track results against the cost-per-part baseline.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the implemented improvements and their cost-per-part results as final?

architect_notes: Length is not given: 16 to 20 weeks is an estimate from the archetype's typical weeks, one plant, and time for savings to show.
No Measurement phase: the cost-per-part criterion may need tracking after launch; confirm whether the quote needs a separate period.
